description:
OSGi bundle and content package that forward every AEM log event to a
        Grafana Loki push endpoint. From 2.x onwards the forwarder is built
        entirely on the standard OSGi Log Reader Service and java.net.http -
        no Logback, no SLF4J SPI, no third-party appender. Every runtime
        setting (URL, credentials, labels, batching, per-logger levels) is
        driven by a single OSGi configuration.
